# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。

item.text: 方案已确定：联想词服务保留 API Proxy 返回的原始 Promise（其上保留请求任务的 `abort`），同时暴露 `{ promise, abort }`；页面每次输入先取消旧请求，并用递增版本号屏蔽取消竞态中的旧响应。清空和卸载都会取消，取消产生的失败不会误报；提示和详情跳转也直接使用 API Proxy，不新增平台适配层。

<script>
import mpx from '@mpxjs/core'

mpx.createApp({
  onLaunch () {
    console.log('shop launched')
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/search/index",
    "pages/product/detail"
  ]
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="search-page">
    <input value="{{keyword}}" bindinput="onKeywordInput" placeholder="搜索商品" />
    <view class="trending" wx:if="{{!keyword}}">
      <view wx:for="{{trendingKeywords}}" wx:key="*this" bindtap="chooseKeyword(item)">{{item}}</view>
    </view>
    <view class="suggestions">
      <view wx:for="{{suggestions}}" wx:key="id" bindtap="openProduct(item.id)">{{item.name}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'
import { navigateTo, showToast } from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'
import { fetchTrendingKeywords, requestSuggestions } from '../../services/search'

createPage({
  data: {
    keyword: '',
    trendingKeywords: [],
    suggestions: []
  },
  async onLoad () {
    this.suggestionRequest = null
    this.searchVersion = 0
    this.isUnloaded = false

    try {
      const trendingKeywords = await fetchTrendingKeywords()
      if (!this.isUnloaded) {
        this.trendingKeywords = trendingKeywords
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!this.isUnloaded) {
        this.showError('趋势词加载失败')
      }
    }
  },
  onUnload () {
    this.isUnloaded = true
    this.searchVersion += 1
    this.abortSuggestionRequest()
  },
  methods: {
    onKeywordInput (event) {
      this.search(event.detail.value)
    },
    chooseKeyword (keyword) {
      this.search(keyword)
    },
    search (keyword) {
      const normalizedKeyword = keyword.trim()
      const currentVersion = ++this.searchVersion

      this.keyword = normalizedKeyword
      this.abortSuggestionRequest()

      if (!normalizedKeyword) {
        this.suggestions = []
        return
      }

      this.suggestions = []
      const suggestionRequest = requestSuggestions(normalizedKeyword)
      this.suggestionRequest = suggestionRequest

      suggestionRequest.promise.then(
        (suggestions) => {
          if (!this.isUnloaded && currentVersion === this.searchVersion) {
            this.suggestions = suggestions
          }
          this.finishSuggestionRequest(currentVersion)
        },
        () => {
          if (!this.isUnloaded && currentVersion === this.searchVersion) {
            this.showError('搜索失败')
          }
          this.finishSuggestionRequest(currentVersion)
        }
      )
    },
    abortSuggestionRequest () {
      if (this.suggestionRequest) {
        this.suggestionRequest.abort()
        this.suggestionRequest = null
      }
    },
    finishSuggestionRequest (version) {
      if (version === this.searchVersion) {
        this.suggestionRequest = null
      }
    },
    showError (message) {
      showToast({
        title: message,
        icon: 'none'
      }).catch(() => {})
    },
    openProduct (productId) {
      navigateTo({
        url: `/pages/product/detail?id=${encodeURIComponent(productId)}`
      }).catch(() => {
        this.showError('跳转失败')
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.search-page { padding: 24rpx; }
.trending, .suggestions { margin-top: 24rpx; }
</style>
